'''Garlvan''' is one of the Aiel [[Aviendha]] sees in her visions of the future in the [[Glass columns]] ''ter'angreal'' in [[Rhuidean]]. 

He is the young son of [[Norlesh]] and [[Metalan]]. He dies of starvation in the arms of his mother.
